cards.whyItMatters: 若结果可复现，说明在离散交易和交易成本约束下，学习型策略可在不额外增加成本的前提下改善波动率风险对冲，为期权组合的风险管理提供一种可落地的数据驱动选项。
cards.summaryEn: The authors train a PPO hedging agent on synthetic data from a stochastic volatility model and compare it with semi-analytical Delta and Delta-Vega benchmarks in simulation. They then benchmark against practitioner Black-Scholes Delta and Delta-Vega strategies on historical S&P 500 index option data. The authors report that PPO matches the Delta-Vega objective at baseline costs and increasingly outperforms it as costs rise; on historical data, two-instrument strategies roughly halve the P&L dispersion of the Delta hedge, and PPO shows lower P&L volatility than Delta-Vega. These results and interpretations are the authors' conclusions and have not been independently replicated.
keyPoints: 代理状态仅含市场可观测变量，使模拟训练的策略可直接应用于市场数据。
模拟中PPO在基线成本下与Delta-Vega目标相当，随交易成本上升而逐步占优；双工具策略一致优于单工具Delta对冲。
历史标普500期权数据上，双工具策略将Delta对冲的盈亏离散度约减半，PPO在可比成本下盈亏波动低于Delta-Vega，优势集中于高波动时段。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If replicated, the results suggest that under discrete trading and transaction costs, a learned policy can improve volatility-risk hedging without extra cost, offering a practical data-driven option for option-portfolio risk management.
cards.title: 深度强化学习实现Delta-Vega对冲：从模拟到市场数据
cards.description: 该研究提出用深度强化学习在离散交易与交易成本下同时对冲标的价格与波动率风险，交易标的资产与另一只期限更长的期权；其新意在于将状态限定为市场可观测变量，使模拟中学到的策略可直接用于真实市场数据。若结论稳健，这为实务中在成本约束下管理波动率敞口提供了数据驱动的替代方案。
cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes a deep reinforcement learning approach to hedge both price and volatility risk under discrete trading and transaction costs, trading the underlying asset plus a second, longer-dated option. Its novelty is restricting the state to market-observable quantities so a policy learned in simulation can be applied directly to market data; if robust, this offers a data-driven alternative for managing volatility exposure under cost constraints.
cards.originalTitle: Delta-Vega Hedging with Deep Reinforcement Learning: From Simulation to Reality
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from the authors' stochastic-volatility simulation and one historical S&P 500 index option dataset; the sample period, cost assumptions and benchmark implementation details are not specified in the abstract. Conclusions depend on model specification and training, with no independent replication or cross-market test. Historical backtest results do not guarantee future performance and do not constitute investment advice.
keyPointsEn: The agent's state contains only market-observable quantities, allowing a simulation-trained policy to be applied directly to market data.

In simulation, PPO matches the Delta-Vega objective at baseline costs and increasingly outperforms it as transaction costs rise; two-instrument strategies consistently beat the single-instrument Delta hedge.

On historical S&P 500 option data, two-instrument strategies roughly halve the P&L dispersion of the Delta hedge; PPO has lower P&L volatility than Delta-Vega at comparable costs, with its advantage concentrated in high-volatility episodes.
cards.limitations: 证据来自作者自建的随机波动率模拟与一段标普500指数期权历史数据，样本区间、成本设定与基准实现细节未在摘要中说明；结论依赖模型设定与训练过程，未提供独立复现或跨市场检验；历史回测结果不代表未来表现，亦不构成投资建议。
cards.titleEn: Delta-Vega Hedging with Deep Reinforcement Learning: From Simulation to Market Data
cards.summary: 作者在随机波动率模型的合成数据上用PPO训练对冲代理，并将其与半解析的Delta与Delta-Vega对冲基准在模拟中比较。随后在标普500指数期权历史数据上与实务常用的Black-Scholes Delta与Delta-Vega策略对比。作者报告：在基线交易成本下PPO达到Delta-Vega的目标，成本上升时逐步占优；在历史数据上双工具策略将Delta对冲的盈亏离散度约减半，PPO的盈亏波动低于Delta-Vega。上述表现与解释属作者结论，尚未经独立复现。

cards.whyItMatters: 该框架为下行风险组合模型提供了统一的可解性分析，明确了不同风险度量性质与组合问题之间的匹配关系，并给出可操作的凸规划与风险预算实现条件，有助于研究者和实践者更严谨地选择与求解下行风险模型。
cards.summaryEn: Fact: The authors classify downside-risk portfolio models by the degree of positive homogeneity of the risk measure in weights and state a non-degeneracy condition on long-only downside risk for three thresholds: the portfolio mean, zero, and a market-index return. Under this condition, the risk-parity, most-diversified and Sortino-ratio problems are well posed, the two ratio problems reduce to convex programs, and differentiability of semivolatility ensures risk budgeting attains prescribed budgets. Opinion: The authors argue that downside-risk models should not be viewed simply as direct extensions of variance-based counterparts, as different portfolio problems require different properties of the risk measure.
keyPoints: 按正齐次性程度分类下行风险模型，一阶齐次性使风险贡献可加且分散化与收益风险比具有尺度不变性。
针对均值、零和市场指数收益三个阈值，给出长仓下行风险的非退化条件，保证风险平价、最分散化和Sortino比率问题良定义。
在该条件下，两个比率问题可化为凸规划，半波动率可微性确保风险预算达到预设值；样本外回测比较17种长仓策略并用块自举检验族内差异。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The framework provides a unified solvability analysis for downside-risk portfolio models, clarifies the matching between risk-measure properties and portfolio problems, and offers operational conditions for convex-program and risk-budgeting implementations, helping researchers and practitioners select and solve downside-risk models more rigorously.
cards.title: 下行风险组合选择：统一框架与可解性条件
cards.description: 该研究在下行风险组合选择中按风险度量的正齐次性程度对模型分类，并针对三个阈值给出非退化条件，使风险平价、最分散化和Sortino比率问题良定义；同时证明两个比率问题可化为凸规划，且半波动率可微性确保风险预算达到预设值。
cards.descriptionEn: This study classifies downside-risk portfolio models by the degree of positive homogeneity of the risk measure in weights and provides a non-degeneracy condition for three thresholds under which risk-parity, most-diversified and Sortino-ratio problems are well posed; it also shows the two ratio problems reduce to convex programs and differentiability of semivolatility ensures risk budgeting attains prescribed budgets.
cards.originalTitle: Semivariance and Semivolatility in Portfolio Selection: A Unified Framework for Downside-Risk Portfolio Models
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundaries: the out-of-sample analysis uses only two total-return datasets of current constituents of the Dow Jones and Nasdaq-100 indexes with a rolling-window backtest; conclusions depend on long-only settings and three specific thresholds, without covering other thresholds or short positions; backtest results are affected by sample period and constituent selection, and block-bootstrap inference only tests within-family differences; no investment advice is provided.
keyPointsEn: Classifies downside-risk models by degree of positive homogeneity; degree one makes risk contributions additive and keeps diversification and reward-to-risk ratios scale invariant.
For three thresholds (mean, zero, market-index return), gives a non-degeneracy condition on long-only downside risk ensuring risk-parity, most-diversified and Sortino-ratio problems are well posed.

Under this condition, the two ratio problems reduce to convex programs and differentiability of semivolatility ensures risk budgeting attains prescribed budgets; out-of-sample backtest compares 17 long-only strategies with block-bootstrap inference within families.
cards.limitations: 证据边界包括：样本外分析仅基于道琼斯和纳斯达克100当前成分股的两个总收益数据集，采用滚动窗口回测；结论依赖长仓设定和三个特定阈值，未覆盖其他阈值或空头情形；回测结果受样本期与成分股选择影响，块自举推断仅检验族内差异；未提供投资建议。
cards.titleEn: Downside-Risk Portfolio Selection: Unified Framework and Solvability Conditions
cards.summary: 事实：作者按风险度量在权重上的正齐次性程度对下行风险组合模型进行分类，并针对均值、零和市场指数收益三个阈值，给出长仓下行风险的非退化条件。在该条件下，风险平价、最分散化和Sortino比率问题良定义，两个比率问题可化为凸规划，半波动率的可微性保证风险预算达到预设值。观点：作者认为下行风险模型不应简单视为方差模型的直接扩展，不同组合问题需要风险度量的不同性质。

cards.whyItMatters: 为量化对冲与期权定价提供将执行成本内生化的一致性框架，说明对冲行为本身会改变待复制收益，并给出从标的限价订单簿形状推导期权价差与订单簿形状的定量线索。
cards.summaryEn: The authors study how price impact and execution costs turn hedging a derivative with the underlying into a moving-target problem rather than replication of a fixed payoff. They characterize replication by a fixed-point equation in a binomial model, derive a nonlinear pricing PDE with an implicit terminal condition in continuous time, and prove exact replication for monotone convex Lipschitz payoffs under midpoint execution costs. Calibrating a one-period binomial model to near-expiry SPY call trade and quote data, they report that the model explains about 85% of the observed option bid-ask spread for near-the-money options; this is a calibrated numerical finding, not a universal theorem.
keyPoints: 在二项模型中，含价格冲击与执行成本的复制由固定点方程刻画，而非传统线性定价。
连续时间下得到非线性定价PDE，其终端条件隐式依赖于对冲交易路径，体现移动目标问题。
对看涨、看跌等单调凸Lipschitz收益，在中间价执行成本下可精确复制；数值实验展示价格冲击移动有效行权价、期权价格对合约数的非线性依赖，以及执行成本平滑终端持仓。
用近到期SPY看涨期权交易与报价数据校准一期二项模型，报告解释约85%的平值附近期权买卖价差。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers a consistent framework for quantitative hedging and option pricing that endogenizes execution costs, shows that hedging itself alters the payoff being replicated, and provides quantitative links from the underlying limit order book shape to option spreads and order book shape.
cards.title: 对冲交易改变期权收益：含价格冲击与执行成本的复制研究
cards.description: 该研究揭示用标的资产对冲衍生品时，交易本身的价格冲击与执行成本会改变原本要复制的收益，提出二项树固定点方程与连续时间非线性定价PDE来刻画这一移动目标问题，并证明在中间价执行成本下对单调凸Lipschitz收益可精确复制。其有用性在于将执行成本内生化于期权定价，并用近到期SPY看涨期权数据校准，解释约85%的平值附近买卖价差。
cards.descriptionEn: The study shows that hedging a derivative with the underlying asset changes the payoff intended for replication when trading generates price impact and execution costs. It characterizes replication via a fixed-point equation in a binomial model and a nonlinear pricing PDE in continuous time, proves exact replication for monotone convex Lipschitz payoffs under midpoint execution costs, and calibrates a one-period binomial model to near-expiry SPY call data, explaining about 85
cards.originalTitle: When Hedging Changes the Payoff: Option Replication with Price Impact and Execution Costs
cards.limitationsEn: The conclusions rely on specific modeling assumptions of the binomial model and the continuous-time PDE; the exact replication result is limited to monotone convex Lipschitz payoffs with midpoint execution costs. The 85% spread explanatory power comes from a single calibration to near-expiry SPY call options and is an empirical fit reported by the authors, not a universal conclusion for all options, maturities, or markets, and does not constitute investment advice.
keyPointsEn: In the binomial model, replication with price impact and execution costs is characterized by a fixed-point equation rather than linear pricing.
In continuous time, a nonlinear pricing PDE arises whose implicit terminal condition captures the hedger's moving-target problem.

For monotone convex Lipschitz payoffs such as calls and puts, exact replication holds under midpoint execution costs; numerical experiments show price impact shifting the effective strike, nonlinear dependence of option price on contract count, and execution costs smoothing terminal holdings.
Calibrating a one-period binomial model to near-expiry SPY call trade and quote data, the authors report explaining about 85% of the observed bid-ask spread for near-the-money options.
cards.limitations: 结论依赖二项模型与连续时间PDE的特定建模假设，精确复制结果仅针对单调凸Lipschitz收益与中间价执行成本；85%的价差解释力来自近到期SPY看涨期权的单一样本校准，属于作者报告的经验拟合，不能外推为对所有期权、到期期限或市场的普遍结论，也不构成投资建议。
cards.titleEn: Hedging Changes the Payoff: Option Replication with Price Impact and Execution Costs
cards.summary: 作者研究用标的资产对冲衍生品时，价格冲击和执行成本如何使对冲目标从固定收益变为移动目标。在二项模型中用固定点方程刻画复制，在连续时间导出带隐式终端条件的非线性定价PDE，并对单调凸Lipschitz收益证明中间价执行成本下可精确复制。作者用近到期SPY看涨期权数据校准一期二项模型，报告模型解释了约85%的平值附近期权买卖价差；这是作者基于特定校准的数值发现，而非普适定理。

cards.whyItMatters: 该工作为Transformer处理路径型数据提供了可证明的学习保证，并把ICL理论推广到样本相关的情形，对需要刻画路径演化非线性的量化预测任务具有方法参考价值；论文报告签名增强模型在较少可训练参数下达到或超过基线。
cards.summaryEn: The paper proposes a path-signature-based theoretical framework for in-context learning by transformers in path space. The authors explicitly construct a causal softmax transformer with two attention heads per layer that emulates in-context Lasso, and derive finite-sample prediction error bounds under sparse signature approximation plus moment and concentration conditions. Experiments cover sparse recovery, nonlinear path regression, execution-cost prediction, and financial payoff inference, with conclusions confined to the paper's model and data assumptions.
keyPoints: 显式构造两层注意力头结构，使Transformer在上下文中实现Lasso式稀疏估计。
分析突破独立同分布假设，允许示范样本与查询之间存在依赖关系。
在稀疏签名近似及矩与集中条件下得到有限样本预测误差界。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The work offers provable learning guarantees for transformers on path-valued data and extends ICL theory to dependent samples, providing methodological reference for quantitative prediction tasks that involve nonlinear path evolution; the paper reports that signature-augmented models match or outperform baselines with substantially fewer trainable parameters.
cards.title: 签名特征赋能Transformer路径空间上下文学习理论
cards.description: 该研究为Transformer在路径空间中的上下文学习建立理论框架，用路径签名特征刻画目标响应对观测路径演化的非线性依赖，并给出有限样本预测误差界；其有用性在于把ICL理论从独立同分布数据扩展到样本间存在依赖的情形，并以显式构造的注意力结构对应上下文Lasso。
cards.descriptionEn: The study builds an in-context learning framework for transformers in path space using path signature features, capturing nonlinear dependence of target responses on the evolution of observed paths while providing finite-sample prediction error bounds; it is useful because it extends ICL theory beyond IID data to dependent demonstrations and queries and explicitly links attention structure to in-context Lasso.
cards.originalTitle: Transformers with Signatures: Towards Universal In-Context Learning in Path Space
cards.limitationsEn: The theoretical results rely on assumptions including sparse signature approximation, moment conditions, and concentration conditions, and the error bounds hold only in the finite-sample setting. Experiments are limited to sparse recovery, path regression, execution-cost prediction, and financial payoff inference, without evidence of general validity for other tasks or real trading environments. The performance comparison is an experimental comparison against vanilla transformer baselines only and does not constitute investment advice or evidence of live-trading applicability.
keyPointsEn: An explicit two-head-per-layer attention construction lets the transformer perform Lasso-style sparse estimation in context.
The analysis relaxes the IID assumption, allowing dependence between demonstrations and the query.
Finite-sample prediction error bounds are derived under sparse signature approximation and moment/concentration conditions.
cards.limitations: 理论结论依赖稀疏签名近似、矩条件与集中条件等假设，误差界仅在有限样本设定下成立；实验集中于稀疏恢复、路径回归、执行成本与金融收益推断等任务，未证明对其他任务或真实交易环境普遍有效；文中性能比较仅为与 vanilla Transformer 基线的实验对比，不构成投资建议或实盘可用性证据。
cards.titleEn: Signature Features Enable Universal In-Context Learning in Path Space
cards.summary: 论文提出以路径签名作为特征，构建Transformer在路径空间中进行上下文学习的理论框架。作者显式构造每层两个注意力头的因果softmax Transformer，使其在上下文中模拟Lasso，并在稀疏签名近似与矩、集中条件下给出有限样本预测误差界。实验覆盖稀疏恢复、非线性路径回归、执行成本预测与金融收益推断，但结论均限于论文设定的模型与数据假设。

cards.whyItMatters: 若该范式成立，工作流构建可减少人工编排，并在长程构建过程中依据真实执行反馈逐步修正，而非一次性生成后才发现问题；同时插件式设计便于替换算子库与大模型后端，利于复用与比较。
cards.summaryEn: The paper identifies three issues in existing agentic workflow construction: human-dependent authoring, lack of graph-level execution feedback, and inability to repair errors in-loop during long-horizon construction. It proposes FlowSteer, where a single agent end-to-end designs the workflow that a downstream executor runs. Its core is the Workflow Canvas, which returns syntax-checked execution feedback for every atomic edit, plus Reinforced Progressive Canvas Editing, where a lightweight policy agent makes one atomic edit per turn and is trained end-to-end with reinforcement learning.
keyPoints: 提出“智能体设计智能体工作流”范式，由单一智能体端到端产出可执行工作流。
Workflow Canvas以图状态环境对每次原子编辑返回经语法检查的执行反馈。
强化渐进式画布编辑让轻量策略智能体每轮仅做一次原子编辑，并用强化学习端到端训练。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If the paradigm holds, workflow construction can reduce manual orchestration and correct issues progressively using real execution feedback during long-horizon building rather than only after one-shot generation; the plug-and-play design also eases swapping operator libraries and LLM backends for reuse and comparison.
cards.title: FlowSteer提出由智能体自主设计可执行工作流的新范式
cards.description: 新在于将工作流构建从人工依赖转为单一智能体端到端设计，并以可执行图状态环境提供原子编辑级反馈；有用之处是让长程构建中能在线发现并修复错误，且支持多种算子库与可替换的大模型后端。
cards.descriptionEn: The novelty is shifting workflow construction from human-dependent authoring to end-to-end design by a single agent, with an executable graph-state environment giving feedback at each atomic edit; it is useful because errors can be caught and repaired in-loop during long-horizon construction, while supporting diverse operator libraries and interchangeable LLM backends.
cards.originalTitle: FlowSteer: Towards Agents Designing Agentic Workflows via Reinforced Progressive Canvas Editing
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from the paper's experiments on twelve datasets and does not cover all task types or real production settings. Performance depends on the quality of syntax-checked feedback from the Workflow Canvas and on the chosen operator libraries and backend models; cross-library and cross-model transferability needs further validation. This is a preprint, conclusions are as reported by the authors, and it does not constitute investment advice.
keyPointsEn: Proposes an "agent designing agentic workflows" paradigm in which a single agent end-to-end produces an executable workflow.
Workflow Canvas is a graph-state environment returning syntax-checked execution feedback for each atomic edit.
Reinforced Progressive Canvas Editing lets a lightweight policy agent issue one atomic edit per turn and trains it end-to-end via reinforcement learning.
cards.limitations: 证据来自论文在十二个数据集上的实验报告，未涵盖全部任务类型与真实生产环境。性能依赖Workflow Canvas的语法检查反馈质量与所选算子库、后端模型能力，跨库与跨模型的可迁移性需进一步验证。该文为预印本，结论以作者报告为准，且不构成任何投资建议。
cards.titleEn: FlowSteer Proposes a Paradigm Where Agents Design Executable Workflows Autonomously
cards.summary: 论文指出既有智能体工作流构建依赖人工、缺少图级执行反馈、长程构建中难以在线修复错误。作者提出FlowSteer范式：一个智能体端到端设计工作流，再由下游执行器运行。其核心是提供每次原子编辑语法检查反馈的Workflow Canvas环境，以及基于该环境、每轮只做一次原子编辑并用强化学习训练的渐进式画布编辑方法。

cards.whyItMatters: 若内部表示能稳定捕捉超越共同风险因子和直接披露距离的企业关联，则可为受监管金融场景中的同行筛选、风险归因和网络资产定价提供可解释的结构性输入，并开辟“预训练模型知道企业什么”的研究方向。
cards.summaryEn: The paper measures financial dissimilarity between firms using frozen representations of four tabular foundation models within a spatial asset-pricing framework for US equities from 2011 to 2025. The authors report that estimated return gains from these representations over a direct distance between the same disclosures are consistently positive once broader SEC filing data are included. They argue that internal representations of foundation models should be studied as economic objects, not only for their predictive performance.
keyPoints: 使用四个表格基础模型的冻结表示作为空间资产定价模型中的财务相异性度量。
纳入更广泛的SEC文件数据后，估计的收益增益相对于直接距离持续为正。
作者将TFM从预测工具重新定位为测度经济结构（如同行筛选、风险归因）的工具。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If internal representations stably capture firm linkages beyond common risk factors and direct disclosure distance, they can provide interpretable structural inputs for peer selection, risk attribution, and network-based asset pricing in regulated financial settings, and open a research line on what pretrained models know about firms.
cards.title: 预训练表格特征可测度企业财务邻近性
cards.description: 该研究将四个表格基础模型（TFM）的冻结内部表示用作美国股票空间资产定价模型中的财务相异性度量，发现纳入更广泛的SEC文件数据后，这些表示相对于同一披露的直接距离所估计的收益增益持续为正。新意在于把TFM从黑箱预测器重新定位为测度经济结构的工具；其用处是可用于同行筛选、风险归因和基于网络的资产定价。
cards.descriptionEn: The study uses frozen internal representations from four tabular foundation models (TFMs) as a measure of financial dissimilarity in a spatial asset-pricing model of US equities, and finds that estimated return gains relative to a direct distance between the same disclosures become consistently positive once broader SEC filing data are included. Its novelty lies in reframing TFMs from black-box predictors into instruments for measuring economic structure, with applications to
cards.originalTitle: Pretrained Tabular Features and the Measurement of Financial Proximity
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based only on US equities from 2011 to 2025 and frozen representations from four TFMs, without coverage of other markets or models; the mechanism by which TFM internal representations are interpretable is not specified; the finding that estimated gains relative to a direct distance are consistently positive depends on including broader SEC filing data, and its robustness and economic significance require independent testing; the paper is an arXiv preprint and has not been peer-reviewed; it does not constitute investment advice.
keyPointsEn: Frozen representations from four tabular foundation models are used as a measure of financial dissimilarity in a spatial asset-pricing model.
Estimated return gains relative to a direct distance become consistently positive once broader SEC filing data are included.
The authors reframe TFMs from prediction tools into instruments for measuring economic structure, such as peer selection and risk attribution.
cards.limitations: 证据仅基于2011至2025年美国股票样本和四个TFM的冻结表示，未覆盖其他市场或模型；未说明TFM内部表示可解释性的具体机制；估计增益相对于直接距离的“持续为正”依赖纳入更广泛的SEC文件数据这一设定，其稳健性和经济显著性需独立检验；论文为预印本，尚未经同行评议；不构成投资建议。
cards.titleEn: Pretrained Tabular Features Measure Financial Proximity
cards.summary: 论文在2011至2025年美国股票的空间资产定价框架中，以四个表格基础模型的冻结表示衡量企业间财务相异性。作者报告，纳入更广泛的SEC文件数据后，这些表示相对直接距离的估计收益增益持续为正。作者据此主张，基础模型的内部表示本身应作为经济对象来研究，而不仅是其预测性能。

cards.whyItMatters: 为相关矩阵清理提供了一种利用外部分组信息的参数化方法，在样本量不足时仍可正定，并在风险平价组合中显示出潜在优势。
cards.summaryEn: Rotationally invariant estimators clean eigenvalues but keep noisy eigenvectors. The MaxVar estimator uses external information (asset groups) to restrict leading eigenvectors to linear combinations of group maximum-variance portfolios and replaces the rest of the spectrum. In an application to 47 futures, simulation distance is reduced by about one third, and the risk parity Sharpe ratio rises from 1.17 (empirical matrix) to 1.28.
keyPoints: MaxVar用资产分组的外部信息修正特征向量，将主特征向量限制在组最大方差组合的线性组合内，其余谱替换为单一特征值。
该估计量是约n个参数的因子模型，而非n²/2，且在观测数小于资产数时仍保持正定。
在47个期货的模拟测试中，MaxVar与参考矩阵的距离降低约三分之一，旋转不变估计量降低不到10%；风险平价组合夏普比率MaxVar为1.28，旋转不变为1.24，经验矩阵为1.17。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It provides a parametric method for cleaning correlation matrices using external group information, remains positive definite in undersampled settings, and shows potential advantages in risk parity portfolios.
cards.title: 外部信息修正相关矩阵：最大方差估计量
cards.description: 提出MaxVar估计量，利用资产分组信息修正相关矩阵的特征向量，在模拟中降低与参考矩阵的距离，并在真实期货数据上提高风险平价组合的夏普比率。
cards.descriptionEn: Proposes the MaxVar estimator that uses asset group information to correct correlation matrix eigenvectors, reducing distance to a reference matrix in simulations and improving the Sharpe ratio of risk parity portfolios on real futures data.
cards.originalTitle: Cleaning correlation matrices with external information: the Maximum Variance estimat
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on a single asset set (47 futures) and a specific grouping (three asset classes); the simulation assumes the reference matrix has the structure assumed by the estimator; the real-data backtest covers 1993–2018 and results may depend on market conditions; other groupings or asset classes are not examined.
keyPointsEn: MaxVar uses asset group information to correct eigenvectors, restricting leading eigenvectors to linear combinations of group maximum-variance portfolios and replacing the remaining spectrum with a single eigenvalue.
It is a factor model with about n parameters instead of n²/2, and remains positive definite even when the number of observations is smaller than the number of assets.

In simulations with 47 futures, MaxVar reduces distance to the reference matrix by about one third versus less than 10% for the rotationally invariant estimator; the risk parity Sharpe ratio is 1.28 for MaxVar, 1.24 for the rotationally invariant estimator, and 1.17 for the empirical matrix.
cards.limitations: 证据基于单一资产集（47个期货）和特定分组（三类资产），模拟测试假设参考矩阵符合估计量结构；真实数据回测区间为1993-2018，结果可能受市场环境影响，未涉及其他分组或资产类别。
cards.titleEn: Cleaning Correlation Matrices with External Information: The Maximum Variance Estimator
cards.summary: 旋转不变估计量仅清理特征值而保留噪声特征向量。MaxVar估计量借助外部信息（资产分组）将主特征向量限制在组最大方差组合的线性组合内，并替换剩余谱。在47个期货的实例中，模拟距离降低约三分之一，风险平价组合夏普比率从1.17（经验矩阵）提升至1.28。

cards.whyItMatters: 深度搜索要求智能体进行多轮信息收集、查询重述和基于证据的验证，而非单次检索。Bathys提供的训练框架和评估协议为提升此类智能体的可靠性和搜索深度提供了可参考的工程路径。
cards.summaryEn: Bathys is a training framework for deep search agents comprising verifiable question synthesis, post-training, and online reinforcement learning. The authors report that Bathys 9B and 27B achieve 66.51% and 80.49% on BrowseComp, respectively, under an evaluation protocol with trajectory self-verification and conditional retries. The above are factual statements from the source abstract; the authors' view is that the framework ensures both search depth and reliability.
keyPoints: 训练框架覆盖可验证问题合成、后训练（SFT、KTO）和在线强化学习（CM-GSPO）。
数据构造将线索改写为需独立检索的间接引用，并保留证据链以验证线索共同确定唯一答案。
Bathys 9B和27B在BrowseComp上的报告成绩分别为66.51%和80.49%。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Deep search requires agents to perform multi-round information gathering, query reformulation, and evidence-based verification rather than a single retrieval step. The training framework and evaluation protocol of Bathys provide a referable engineering path for improving the reliability and search depth of such agents.
cards.title: Bathys深度搜索智能体：训练框架与基准表现
cards.description: Bathys提出了一套涵盖可验证问题合成、后训练和在线强化学习的训练框架，并构建了9B和27B两个深度搜索智能体。其价值在于通过数据构造和训练流程设计，提升智能体在复杂开放任务中迭代检索、重述查询和基于证据验证答案的能力。
cards.descriptionEn: Bathys presents a training framework spanning verifiable question synthesis, post-training, and online reinforcement learning, and builds 9B and 27B deep search agents. Its value lies in improving agents' ability to iteratively retrieve information, reformulate queries, and verify evidence-based answers in complex open-ended tasks through data construction and training pipeline design.
cards.limitationsEn: The source abstract reports results only on BrowseComp and does not provide generalization evidence on other benchmarks or real-world scenarios. The evaluation protocol includes trajectory self-verification and conditional retries, which may affect the reported scores. Details of data construction and training pipeline are not expanded in the abstract, leaving reproducibility and external validity to be verified.
keyPointsEn: The training framework covers verifiable question synthesis, post-training (SFT, KTO), and online reinforcement learning (CM-GSPO).
Data construction reformulates clues as indirect references requiring independent retrieval and retains evidence chains to verify that clues jointly determine a unique answer.
Bathys 9B and 27B report scores of 66.51% and 80.49% on BrowseComp, respectively.
cards.limitations: 来源摘要仅报告了BrowseComp上的成绩，未提供其他基准或真实场景的泛化证据。评估协议包含轨迹自验证和条件重试，成绩可能受该协议影响。训练数据构造和训练流程的细节未在摘要中展开，复现性和外部有效性有待验证。
cards.titleEn: Bathys Deep Search Agents: Training Framework and Benchmark Performance
cards.summary: Bathys是一个面向深度搜索任务的智能体训练框架，包含可验证问题合成、后训练和在线强化学习三个阶段。作者报告Bathys 9B和27B在BrowseComp上分别达到66.51%和80.49%，评估协议包含轨迹自验证和条件重试。上述为论文来源摘要中的事实陈述，作者观点认为该框架能同时保证搜索深度和可靠性。

cards.whyItMatters: 该工作把可训练性与量子比特开销作为混合量子网络设计的核心约束，并尝试用统一框架应对异构数据任务，为理解紧凑电路选择与专家融合在跨域学习中的作用提供了可复现的实验线索。
cards.summaryEn: The paper addresses poor trainability, rigid circuit design, and weak robustness of hybrid quantum neural networks across heterogeneous tasks by proposing TQ-HQNet. The authors report balanced-accuracy gains of +0.280, +0.170, +0.071, and +0.060 over a fixed hybrid quantum baseline on neurological screening, phishing detection, financial direction prediction, and DNA sequence classification. Ablation and sensitivity analyses suggest the gains come from trainability-aware compact circuit selection and expert fusion rather than circuit scaling.
keyPoints: 框架由三部分构成：自适应潜压缩把领域特征映射为量子比特兼容表示，可训练性感知搜索紧凑变分电路候选，以及融合多个浅层量子专家。
四个公开数据集上，相对固定混合量子基线报告平衡准确率增益 +0.280、+0.170、+0.071、+0.060。
消融与敏感性研究支持增益主要来自紧凑电路选择与专家融合，而非电路规模扩展。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The work treats trainability and qubit cost as core constraints for hybrid quantum network design and attempts a unified framework for heterogeneous tasks, providing reproducible experimental clues about the roles of compact circuit selection and expert fusion in cross-domain learning.
cards.title: 面向异构数据的可训练性与量子比特高效混合量子网络
cards.description: 提出 TQ-HQNet，用自适应潜压缩、可训练性感知的紧凑变分电路搜索与多浅层量子专家融合，在四个异构公开数据集上稳定优于固定混合量子基线，为跨域混合量子学习提供可训练性与比特效率兼顾的设计思路。
cards.descriptionEn: TQ-HQNet combines adaptive latent compression, trainability-aware search over compact variational circuits, and fusion of multiple shallow quantum experts, reporting consistent gains over a fixed hybrid quantum baseline across four heterogeneous public datasets and offering a design direction that balances trainability and qubit efficiency.
cards.originalTitle: TQ-HQNet: A Trainability-Aware and Qubit-Efficient Hybrid Quantum Neural Network for Cross-Domain Learning on Heterogeneous Data
cards.limitationsEn: Results are based only on four public datasets and comparisons against a fixed hybrid quantum baseline, and classical baselines outperform on some tasks. The authors note that repeated-split evaluation and hardware-aware studies remain future work, so the evidence is bounded to fixed-split simulation or experimental settings and does not establish general superiority or real quantum hardware deployment performance.
keyPointsEn: The framework comprises adaptive latent compression mapping domain features to qubit-compatible representations, trainability-aware search over compact variational circuit candidates, and fusion of multiple shallow quantum experts.
On four public datasets, reported balanced-accuracy gains over a fixed hybrid quantum baseline are +0.280, +0.170, +0.071, and +0.060.
Ablation and sensitivity studies support that gains mainly arise from compact circuit selection and expert fusion, not circuit scaling.
cards.limitations: 结果仅基于四个公开数据集和与固定混合量子基线的比较，部分任务上经典基线表现更好；作者也指出重复划分评估与硬件感知研究仍属未来工作，因此当前结论的证据边界限于固定划分下的仿真或实验设定，不能外推为普遍优越性或实际量子硬件部署效果。
cards.titleEn: Trainability-Aware and Qubit-Efficient Hybrid Quantum Neural Network for Heterogeneous Data
cards.summary: 论文关注混合量子神经网络在近噪声中等规模量子时代的可训练性差、电路设计僵硬与跨异构任务稳健性不足问题，提出 TQ-HQNet 框架。作者报告在神经筛查、钓鱼检测、金融方向预测和 DNA 序列分类四个公开数据集上，平衡准确率相对固定混合量子基线分别提升 +0.280、+0.170、+0.071 与 +0.060。作者通过消融与敏感性分析认为增益来自可训练性感知的紧凑电路选择与专家融合，而非电路规模扩大。

cards.whyItMatters: 金融文档中常见人工修改标记，传统OCR忽略这些意图线索会导致转录错误。该工作将修改标记纳入OCR推理，为交互式文档理解提供新任务定义、数据资源和紧凑模型方案，有助于减少人工复核成本。
cards.summaryEn: The paper proposes intent-aware OCR, a task where models must interpret edit marks such as arrows, carets, and strikethroughs as intended corrections and output revised transcriptions. The authors construct the DocIntent multimodal dataset and IntentBench benchmark, and fine-tune the DocIntentOCR model family on this data. On IntentBench, the fine-tuned 3B and 7B models achieve F1 scores of 0.81 and 0.83, outperforming GPT-4.1 (0.626) and LLaMA-3.2-Vision-90B (0.50).
keyPoints: 提出意图感知OCR任务：将文档上的手写/数字修改标记视为语义编辑操作而非视觉噪声。
发布DocIntent数据集（1,600份金融文档、5,700余个意图标注）与IntentBench基准（216份文档）。
微调的3B和7B DocIntentOCR模型在IntentBench上F1达0.81和0.83，优于多个更大规模通用模型。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Financial documents often contain human correction marks; conventional OCR ignores these intent cues and produces incorrect transcriptions. This work incorporates edit marks into OCR reasoning, offering a new task definition, data resources, and compact model solutions for interactive document understanding, potentially reducing manual review effort.
cards.title: 意图感知OCR：让视觉修改标记成为语义编辑信号
cards.description: 现有OCR系统将文档上的手写或数字修改标记视为视觉噪声，本文提出意图感知OCR任务，联合推理原始内容与视觉意图线索生成修正后转录。作者构建DocIntent数据集（1,600份金融文档，5,700余个意图标注）和IntentBench基准（216份文档），并微调3B/7B视觉语言模型DocIntentOCR。
cards.descriptionEn: Existing OCR systems treat handwritten or digital correction marks on documents as visual noise. This paper introduces intent-aware OCR, which jointly reasons over original content and visual intent cues to generate corrected transcriptions. The authors build DocIntent (1,600 financial documents with over 5,700 annotated intent cues) and IntentBench (216 documents), and fine-tune 3B/7B vision-language models (DocIntentOCR).
cards.originalTitle: When Ink Meets Pixel: Intent-Aware OCR with VLMs for Human-Corrected Financial Documents When Ink Meets Pixel: Intent-Aware OCR with VLMs for Human-Corrected Financial Documents
cards.limitationsEn: Experiments are limited to the financial document domain and the authors' own dataset/benchmark; generalization to other document types and annotation styles is not validated. F1 scores are based on a specific evaluation setup, with no robustness analysis across domains or annotators. Model sizes cover only 3B and 7B, leaving performance boundaries of larger or smaller models unexplored.
keyPointsEn: Introduces intent-aware OCR, treating handwritten/digital correction marks as semantic edit operations rather than visual noise.
Releases DocIntent (1,600 financial documents, 5,700+ annotated intent cues) and IntentBench (216 documents).
Fine-tuned 3B and 7B DocIntentOCR models reach F1 of 0.81 and 0.83 on IntentBench, surpassing several larger general-purpose models.
cards.limitations: 实验局限于金融文档领域和作者构建的数据集/基准，结论向其他文档类型与标注风格的泛化性未经验证；F1分数基于特定评测设置，未报告跨领域或跨标注者的稳健性分析；模型规模仅覆盖3B和7B，未探讨更大或更小模型的表现边界。
cards.titleEn: Intent-Aware OCR: Treating Visual Edit Marks as Semantic Signals
cards.summary: 论文提出意图感知OCR新任务，要求模型识别文档上箭头、插入符、删除线等修改标记所表达的编辑意图，并输出修正后的转录文本。作者构建了DocIntent多模态数据集和IntentBench评测基准，并基于此微调DocIntentOCR系列模型。在IntentBench上，微调的3B和7B模型F1分别为0.81和0.83，超过GPT-4.1（0.626）和LLaMA-3.2-Vision-90B（0.50）。

cards.whyItMatters: 对希望动手理解语言模型训练全流程的学习者和开发者，这类小规模、短周期的项目可作为教学与实验起点，也便于在有限算力条件下复现。
cards.summaryEn: minimind, listed on GitHub Trending, claims to train a 64M-parameter large language model from scratch in two hours. The content is an engineering demonstration rather than peer-reviewed research, and the time and scale figures come from the project's own description.
keyPoints: 项目定位为从零训练 64M 参数语言模型，强调完整训练流程。
项目宣称训练耗时约两小时，降低了尝试门槛。
内容来自 GitHub Trending 与项目自述，未见独立评测信息。
cards.whyItMattersEn: For learners and developers who want hands-on understanding of the full language-model training pipeline, a small-scale, short-cycle project like this can serve as a teaching and experimentation starting point that is feasible on limited compute.
cards.title: 两小时从零训练 64M 小语言模型的开源项目
cards.description: 该项目展示了一条从零训练 64M 参数语言模型的完整路线，声称训练可在两小时内完成，为理解大模型训练流程提供了低门槛、可复现的实践入口。
cards.descriptionEn: The project presents an end-to-end route for training a 64M-parameter language model from scratch, claiming the training can be completed in about two hours, offering a low-barrier, reproducible entry point for understanding LLM training.
cards.limitationsEn: Training time and results are self-reported, with no third-party reproduction or benchmark evaluation; a 64M-parameter model is far less capable than mainstream large models, and its results cannot be used to infer training costs or performance of larger models.
keyPointsEn: The project targets training a 64M-parameter language model from scratch and emphasizes the full pipeline.
It claims roughly two hours of training time, lowering the barrier to try it.
Information comes from GitHub Trending and the project's own description, with no independent evaluation.
cards.limitations: 训练耗时与效果均来自项目自述，缺少第三方复现与基准评测；64M 参数模型的能力边界远小于主流大模型，不能据此推断更大模型的训练成本或性能。
cards.titleEn: Open-source project for training a 64M language model from scratch in two hours
cards.summary: GitHub Trending 收录的项目 minimind 主张用两小时从零训练一个 64M 参数的大语言模型。项目内容属于工程实践展示，而非同行评审研究，其时间与规模数据来自项目自我介绍。

cards.whyItMatters: 如果智能体能利用空闲时间从自身历史轨迹中提炼技能，能力积累就不必完全依赖在线请求期间的学习；这对降低重复试错成本、让智能体随使用逐步适应具体任务具有潜在意义。
cards.summaryEn: Fact: the content states that agents can, during idle time when not serving requests, review their past runs, learn from mistakes and convert yesterday's traces into reusable skills, illustrated by a coding agent remembering tomorrow a fix it spent ten minutes on today. Author's view: DeepLearning.AI argues for building agents that improve with every task and promotes a free short course, "Building Adaptive AI Agents," built with Oracle.
keyPoints: 闲置时段可用于复盘历史运行轨迹并从中学习
学习结果可沉淀为可复用的技能，而非仅留在单次会话中
文中示例：编码智能体修复过的错误可在后续被记住
cards.whyItMattersEn: If agents can distill skills from their own historical traces during idle time, capability accumulation need not depend entirely on learning during live requests; this may reduce repeated trial-and-error and help agents adapt to specific tasks over continued use.
cards.title: 智能体空闲时学习：将历史运行转化为可复用技能
cards.description: DeepLearning.AI 提出一种让智能体在非服务时段复盘过往运行、从错误中学习并将经验固化为可复用技能的做法；其价值在于无需在线交互即可积累能力，并以编码智能体修复错误为例说明经验可跨时间复用。
cards.descriptionEn: DeepLearning.AI describes letting agents review past runs, learn from mistakes and turn prior traces into reusable skills during idle periods; its value lies in accumulating capability without online interaction, illustrated by a coding agent reusing a fix across time.
cards.originalTitle: Agents that learn while they're idle #deeplearningai #aiagents #oracle
cards.limitationsEn: The provided content is a promotional short-video blurb for a course, with no experimental data, methodological detail, evaluation metrics or comparative results; the "ten-minute fix, remembered next day" example is illustrative and not a verified performance claim; risks such as error propagation in consolidated skills, forgetting and safety are not addressed; it is not investment or procurement advice.
keyPointsEn: Idle periods can be used to review past run traces and learn from them
Learning outputs can be consolidated into reusable skills rather than staying within a single session
Example given: a coding agent can remember a fix it previously made
cards.limitations: 所给内容仅为课程宣传性短视频简介，未提供实验数据、方法细节、评测指标或对照结果；示例中的“十分钟修复错误、次日记住”属说明性表述，不能视为已证实的性能结论；也未讨论技能沉淀的错误传播、遗忘与安全问题；不构成任何投资或采购建议。
cards.titleEn: Agents That Learn While Idle: Turning Past Runs into Reusable Skills
cards.summary: 事实：该内容指出智能体在不处理请求的闲置时间可以回顾自身过去的运行轨迹，从错误中学习，并将昨天的运行记录转化为可复用的技能；并举例说编码智能体今天花十分钟修复的错误，明天可以记住该修复方法。作者观点：DeepLearning.AI 认为应当构建随着每次工作而不断变好的智能体，并引流至与 Oracle 合作推出的免费短课程“Building Adaptive AI Agents”。

cards.whyItMatters: 对追踪量化博客动态的读者，此类汇总可作为发现组合优化等主题新讨论的入口，并帮助定位某个连载系列的起止节点。
cards.summaryEn: The page is Quantocracy's roundup of recent quant blog links as of November 24, 2026, and does not itself present new empirical findings. It notes that Investment Idiocy's 'Fitting blunt instrument weights' is post #12 in its 2026 portfolio optimization series and, per the blog author, the last one. That series-completion claim is the author's own statement.
keyPoints: 页面性质是量化博客链接聚合，主要提供外部文章入口而非原创研究
被链接文章之一是 Investment Idiocy 的“粗糙工具权重”，属 2026 年组合优化系列
该系列据博客作者表述在第 12 篇后结束
cards.whyItMattersEn: For readers tracking quant blog activity, such roundups can serve as an entry point for discovering new discussion on topics such as portfolio optimization and for locating the start and end points of a series.
cards.title: 量化博客链接汇总及组合优化系列收尾
cards.description: 该内容为 Quantocracy 于 2026 年 11 月 24 日汇总的近期量化博客链接列表。新意在于它只是一份聚合索引，而非独立研究；其用处是让读者了解该时点被收录的量化文章条目，其中 Investment Idiocy 的 2026 年组合优化系列第 12 篇为该系列最后一篇。
cards.descriptionEn: This is Quantocracy's roundup of recent quant blog links as of November 24, 2026. Its novelty is that it is an aggregated index rather than an independent study; its usefulness is pointing readers to the articles featured at that time, including the twelfth and reportedly final post of Investment Idiocy's 2026 portfolio optimization series.
cards.originalTitle: Recent Quant Links from Quantocracy as of 11/24/2026
cards.limitationsEn: The input is only a link roundup with a brief introduction; it provides no methods, data, backtest results, or statistical evidence, so the reliability of the linked articles' conclusions cannot be assessed from it. The claim about the series ending and its post count comes from the blog author and is not independently verified. The roundup should not be treated as research conclusions or investment guidance.
keyPointsEn: The page is a quant blog link aggregation, mainly providing entry points to external articles rather than original research
One linked article is Investment Idiocy's 'Fitting blunt instrument weights', part of a 2026 portfolio optimization series
According to the blog author, the series ends after post #12
cards.limitations: 输入内容仅为链接汇总与简短导语，未提供任何方法、数据、回测结果或统计证据，无法据此评估被链接文章结论的可靠性；系列结束与篇数信息来自博客作者自述，未经独立核实；不应将链接汇总视为研究结论或投资依据。
cards.titleEn: Quant Blog Link Roundup and End of a Portfolio Optimization Series
cards.summary: 该页面是 Quantocracy 截至 2026 年 11 月 24 日收录的近期量化博客链接汇总，本身不提出新的实证结论。其中提到 Investment Idiocy 的“粗糙工具权重”一文是其 2026 年组合优化系列的第 12 篇，也是该系列的最后一篇，这一判断属于博客作者的表述。

cards.whyItMatters: 对于需要批量制作短视频的内容创作者，AutoClip 提供了无需订阅、数据本地处理的替代方案，可降低长期成本并增强隐私控制。
cards.summaryEn: AutoClip is an open-source desktop tool focused on local-first AI video clipping with no subscription fees. It can automatically cut long videos into short clips and generate subtitles, covers, and publishing copy for multiple social platforms. It positions itself as an open-source alternative to OpusClip and offers integration as an MCP server.
keyPoints: 本地优先的 AI 剪辑，零订阅费用
一键将长视频转为适配多平台的短视频
自动生成字幕、封面和发布文案
cards.whyItMattersEn: For content creators who need to produce short videos in batches, AutoClip offers a subscription-free, locally processed alternative that can reduce long-term costs and enhance privacy control.
cards.title: AutoClip：本地优先的开源AI视频剪辑工具
cards.description: AutoClip 是 OpusClip 的开源替代方案，采用本地优先架构，支持 MCP 服务器，零订阅费用。它可将播客、访谈、课程等长视频自动剪辑为适合抖音、小红书、TikTok、Reels 与 YouTube Shorts 的短视频，并生成字幕、封面和发布文案。
cards.descriptionEn: AutoClip is an open-source, local-first alternative to OpusClip with a zero-subscription model and MCP server support. It automatically turns long videos such as podcasts, interviews, and courses into short clips tailored for Douyin, Xiaohongshu, TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts, while generating subtitles, covers, and publishing copy.
cards.limitationsEn: The source only provides a project introduction and lacks empirical data on clipping quality, processing speed, or platform compatibility, nor does it specify system requirements or open-source license details; actual performance should be verified by users.
keyPointsEn: Local-first AI clipping with zero subscription fees
One-click conversion of long videos into short clips for multiple platforms
Automatic generation of subtitles, covers, and publishing copy
cards.limitations: 来源信息仅包含项目简介，未提供剪辑质量、处理速度、平台兼容性等实测数据，也未说明系统要求与开源许可证细节；其实际效果需用户自行验证。
cards.titleEn: AutoClip: A Local-First Open-Source AI Video Clipping Tool
cards.summary: AutoClip 是一个开源桌面工具，主打本地优先的 AI 视频剪辑，无需订阅。它能把长视频自动切成短视频，并生成字幕、封面和发布文案，适配多个社交平台。其定位是 OpusClip 的开源替代品，并作为 MCP 服务器提供集成能力。
